{{< include ../_provenance.qmd >}}

Per-compartment exploration using **SCTransform** — the same assay and processing
used by the targets pipeline.

- **Section 1** shows the pipeline UMAP (from `mpn_processed_data_*` targets).
- **Sections 2–3** show the elbow plot, PCA scatter, and PCA vs Harmony UMAP
  comparison (from `dim_grid_sct_pre_*` targets).
- **Sections 4–6** show UMAP and clustering results across the dims × k grid
  (from `dim_grid_sct_runs_*` targets).

```{r setup}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(targets)
```

```{r params}
targets::tar_load(proc_params)

N_DIMS       <- proc_params$n_pca_dims
K            <- proc_params$k_neighbors
DIMS_GRID    <- unlist(proc_params$dim_grid_dims)
K_GRID       <- unlist(proc_params$dim_grid_k)
INSPECT_RES  <- proc_params$marker_resolution
clust_prefix <- paste0("^sNN_pca\\.", proc_params$ref_assay, "_")

SUBSET_NAMES <- c("hsc", "mnc", "stroma")

# Order cells by expression in UMAP plots (high values on top)
ORDER_CELLS  <- FALSE
```

```{r helpers}
cluster_col_res <- function(md, res) {
  pat <- paste0("_res\\.", gsub("\\.", "\\\\.", res), "$")
  grep(pat, colnames(md), value = TRUE)[1]
}

scatter_emb <- function(df, x, y, colour_col, title, guide_title) {
  ggplot(df, aes(x = .data[[x]], y = .data[[y]], colour = .data[[colour_col]])) +
    geom_point(size = 0.7, alpha = 0.5) +
    labs(title = title, colour = guide_title) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 4))) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.text = element_text(size = 7))
}
```

---

## 1. Pipeline UMAP (cached objects) {.tabset}

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r pipeline-umap-tabs}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5

for (nm in SUBSET_NAMES) {
  cat("\n\n### ", nm, "\n\n")

  target_nm <- paste0("mpn_processed_data_", nm)
  targets::tar_load_raw(target_nm)
  srt <- get(target_nm)
  rm(list = target_nm)

  umap_emb           <- as.data.frame(Seurat::Embeddings(srt, "umap.nn")[, 1:2])
  colnames(umap_emb) <- c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")
  clust_cols         <- grep(clust_prefix, colnames(srt@meta.data), value = TRUE)
  df                 <- cbind(umap_emb,
                               srt@meta.data[, c("sample.name", clust_cols), drop = FALSE])
  rm(srt); gc()

  clust_col    <- cluster_col_res(df, INSPECT_RES)
  df[[clust_col]] <- factor(df[[clust_col]])
  centroids <- df |>
    group_by(.data[[clust_col]]) |>
    summarise(UMAP1 = median(UMAP1), UMAP2 = median(UMAP2), .groups = "drop")

  p_sample <- scatter_emb(df, "UMAP1", "UMAP2", "sample.name",
                          paste0(nm, " — coloured by sample"), "Sample")

  p_cluster <- ggplot(df, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, colour = .data[[clust_col]])) +
    geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
    ggrepel::geom_label_repel(data = centroids,
                              aes(label = .data[[clust_col]]),
                              size = 3, show.legend = FALSE,
                              label.padding = unit(0.15, "lines"),
                              max.overlaps = Inf) +
    labs(title = paste0(nm, " — coloured by cluster  (res ", INSPECT_RES, ")")) +
    theme_void(base_size = 9) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

  print(p_sample | p_cluster)
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

:::

## 2. SCTransform → PCA {.tabset}

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r pca-tabs}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 6

for (nm in SUBSET_NAMES) {
  cat("\n\n### ", nm, "\n\n")

  target_nm <- paste0("dim_grid_sct_pre_", nm)
  targets::tar_load_raw(target_nm)
  pre <- get(target_nm)
  rm(list = target_nm)

  p_elbow <- ggplot(pre$elbow, aes(x = dims, y = stdev)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_vline(xintercept = N_DIMS, linetype = "dashed", colour = "firebrick") +
    labs(title    = paste0("PCA elbow — ", nm),
         subtitle = paste0("Dashed = n_pca_dims = ", N_DIMS),
         x = "PC", y = "Std Dev") +
    theme_bw()

  p_pca <- scatter_emb(pre$pca, "PC1", "PC2", "sample",
                       paste0("PCA — ", nm), "Sample")

  print(p_elbow / p_pca)
  rm(pre); gc()
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## 3. PCA vs Harmony UMAP — coloured by sample {.tabset}

Visual comparison of UMAP computed from PCA vs Harmony-corrected embeddings.
Harmony is run on `sample.name` for batch correction assessment only — it is
not used in any downstream analysis.

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r harmony-comparison-tabs}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5

for (nm in SUBSET_NAMES) {
  cat("\n\n### ", nm, "\n\n")

  target_nm <- paste0("dim_grid_sct_pre_", nm)
  targets::tar_load_raw(target_nm)
  pre <- get(target_nm)
  rm(list = target_nm)

  p_pca <- scatter_emb(pre$umap_nn, "UMAP1", "UMAP2", "sample",
                       paste0(nm, " — Pipeline UMAP (umap.nn)"), "Sample")
  p_har <- scatter_emb(pre$umap_harmony, "UMAP1", "UMAP2", "sample",
                       paste0(nm, " — Harmony UMAP"), "Sample")
  print(p_pca | p_har)
  rm(pre); gc()
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## 5. UMAP — coloured by cluster (res `r INSPECT_RES`) {.tabset}

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r umap-cluster-tabs}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8

for (nm in SUBSET_NAMES) {
  cat("\n\n### ", nm, "\n\n")

  target_nm <- paste0("dim_grid_sct_runs_", nm)
  targets::tar_load_raw(target_nm)
  runs <- get(target_nm)
  rm(list = target_nm)

  plots <- list()
  for (lbl in names(runs)) {
    df        <- runs[[lbl]]
    col       <- cluster_col_res(df, INSPECT_RES)
    df[[col]] <- factor(df[[col]])
    centroids <- df |> group_by(.data[[col]]) |>
      summarise(UMAP1 = median(UMAP1), UMAP2 = median(UMAP2), .groups = "drop")
    plots[[lbl]] <- ggplot(df, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, colour = .data[[col]])) +
      geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
      ggrepel::geom_label_repel(data = centroids,
                                aes(label = .data[[col]]),
                                size = 3, show.legend = FALSE,
                                label.padding = unit(0.15, "lines"),
                                max.overlaps = Inf) +
      labs(title = lbl) +
      theme_void(base_size = 9) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
  }
  print(wrap_plots(plots, ncol = length(K_GRID)))
  rm(runs); gc()
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## 6. Resolution scan {.tabset}

Pick one run per subset and inspect how cluster count varies with resolution.

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r res-scan-tabs}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 8

for (nm in SUBSET_NAMES) {
  cat("\n\n### ", nm, "\n\n")

  target_nm <- paste0("dim_grid_sct_runs_", nm)
  targets::tar_load_raw(target_nm)
  runs <- get(target_nm)
  rm(list = target_nm)

  inspect_run <- paste0("dims", N_DIMS, "_k", K)
  if (!inspect_run %in% names(runs)) inspect_run <- names(runs)[1]
  df <- runs[[inspect_run]]

  clust_cols <- grep(paste0(clust_prefix, ".*_res\\."), colnames(df), value = TRUE)

  res_rows <- list()
  for (col in clust_cols) {
    res_rows[[col]] <- data.frame(
      resolution = sub(paste0(clust_prefix, "\\d+_"), "", col),
      n_clusters = nlevels(factor(df[[col]]))
    )
  }
  res_summary <- do.call(rbind, res_rows)
  rm(res_rows)

  p_bar <- ggplot(res_summary, aes(x = resolution, y = n_clusters)) +
    geom_col(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.8) +
    labs(title = paste0("Cluster count vs resolution — ", nm, " (", inspect_run, ")"),
         x = "Resolution", y = "# clusters") +
    theme_bw()

  strip_plots <- list()
  for (col in clust_cols) {
    res_label    <- sub(paste0(clust_prefix, "\\d+_"), "", col)
    n_cl         <- nlevels(factor(df[[col]]))
    df[[col]]    <- factor(df[[col]])
    centroids    <- df |> group_by(.data[[col]]) |>
      summarise(UMAP1 = median(UMAP1), UMAP2 = median(UMAP2), .groups = "drop")
    strip_plots[[col]] <- ggplot(df, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, colour = .data[[col]])) +
      geom_point(size = 0.4, alpha = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
      ggrepel::geom_label_repel(data = centroids, aes(label = .data[[col]]),
                                size = 2.5, show.legend = FALSE,
                                label.padding = unit(0.12, "lines"),
                                max.overlaps = Inf) +
      labs(title = paste0(res_label, "  (", n_cl, " cl)")) +
      theme_void(base_size = 8) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 8, hjust = 0.5))
  }

  col_inspect <- cluster_col_res(df, INSPECT_RES)
  cluster_tbl <- df |>
    count(.data[[col_inspect]], name = "n_cells") |>
    rename(cluster = 1) |>
    mutate(pct = round(100 * n_cells / sum(n_cells), 1)) |>
    arrange(desc(n_cells))

  p_sizes <- ggplot(cluster_tbl, aes(x = reorder(cluster, -n_cells), y = n_cells)) +
    geom_col(fill = "mediumpurple", alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0(pct, "%")), vjust = -0.4, size = 3) +
    labs(title = paste0("Cluster sizes — ", nm, "  res ", INSPECT_RES),
         x = "Cluster", y = "# cells") +
    theme_bw()

  print(p_bar)
  print(wrap_plots(strip_plots, ncol = 3))
  print(p_sizes)
  rm(runs); gc()
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

:::

## 7. SCENT potency scores (scaled) {.tabset}

Compute signaling entropy (SCENT) potency scores to estimate cellular stemness/differentiation state. Scores are scaled 0-1 per compartment. Higher scores indicate higher potency (stemness); lower scores indicate more differentiated states.

**Note:** Set `ORDER_CELLS = TRUE` in params chunk to plot high-potency cells on top (default: FALSE).

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r scent-load}
#| results: asis

# Load precomputed SCENT metadata from targets (includes scores + metadata)
scent_meta <- list()
for (nm in SUBSET_NAMES) {
  target_nm <- paste0("scent_meta_", nm)
  targets::tar_load_raw(target_nm)
  scent_meta[[nm]] <- get(target_nm)
  rm(list = target_nm)
}
```

```{r scent-umap-tabs}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 8

for (nm in SUBSET_NAMES) {
  cat("\n\n### ", nm, "\n\n")

  # Load Seurat object for UMAP coords and metadata
  target_nm <- paste0("mpn_processed_data_", nm)
  targets::tar_load_raw(target_nm)
  srt <- get(target_nm)
  rm(list = target_nm)

  # Get UMAP coords and join with SCENT metadata
  umap_emb <- Seurat::Embeddings(srt, "umap.nn")[, 1:2] %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    setNames(c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("cell.name") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(scent_meta[[nm]], by = "cell.name")

  # Order cells by expression if requested (high values plotted on top)
  if (ORDER_CELLS) {
    umap_emb <- umap_emb %>% dplyr::arrange(scaled_potency)
  }

  # Scaled potency UMAP faceted by sample
  p_scaled <- ggplot(umap_emb, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, colour = scaled_potency)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "turbo") +
    facet_wrap(~ sample.name, ncol = 3) +
    labs(title = paste0(nm, " — SCENT scaled potency (0-1)"),
         colour = "Scaled\nPotency") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")

  print(p_scaled)

  rm(srt); gc()
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

```{r scent-violin-tabs}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5

for (nm in SUBSET_NAMES) {
  cat("\n\n### ", nm, " — Violin by cluster\n\n")

  # Load Seurat object for metadata
  target_nm <- paste0("mpn_processed_data_", nm)
  targets::tar_load_raw(target_nm)
  srt <- get(target_nm)
  rm(list = target_nm)

  # Get cluster column
  clust_col <- cluster_col_res(srt@meta.data, INSPECT_RES)

  # Prepare data for violin plot
  plot_df <- tibble::tibble(
    cell.name = colnames(srt),
    cluster   = srt@meta.data[[clust_col]]
  ) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(scent_meta[[nm]], by = "cell.name")

  # Order clusters by median scaled potency
  cluster_order <- plot_df %>%
    dplyr::group_by(cluster) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(median_potency = median(scaled_potency, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::arrange(desc(median_potency)) %>%
    dplyr::pull(cluster)

  plot_df$cluster <- factor(plot_df$cluster, levels = cluster_order)

  # Scaled potency violin
  p_scaled_violin <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = cluster, y = scaled_potency, fill = cluster)) +
    geom_violin(scale = "width", alpha = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.5, outlier.size = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
    labs(title = paste0(nm, " — SCENT scaled potency by cluster (res ", INSPECT_RES, ")"),
         x = "Cluster", y = "Scaled potency (0-1)") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

  print(p_scaled_violin)

  rm(srt); gc()
  cat("\n\n")
}
```


```{r scent-scatter-tabs}

  # Shuffle rows for random plotting order
  plot_df <- scent_meta[[nm]] %>%
    dplyr::slice_sample(prop = 1)

  # Scatter plot with lm line per sample

    geom_point(size = 0.5, alpha = 0.3) +

         colour = "Sample") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")

  print(p_scatter)
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

## 8. CytoTRACE differentiation scores {.tabset}

Compute CytoTRACE scores to predict differentiation state. Higher scores indicate stem-like/progenitor states; lower scores indicate terminally differentiated cells.

**Note:** Set `ORDER_CELLS = TRUE` in params chunk to plot high-scoring cells on top (default: FALSE).

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r cytotrace-compute}
#| results: asis

cytotrace_results <- list()

for (nm in SUBSET_NAMES) {
  cat("Processing", nm, "...\n")

  target_nm <- paste0("mpn_processed_data_", nm)
  targets::tar_load_raw(target_nm)
  srt <- get(target_nm)
  rm(list = target_nm)

  # Compute CytoTRACE scores
  cytotrace_df <- get_cytotrace(srt)

  # Add scores to metadata
  srt <- Seurat::AddMetaData(srt, cytotrace_df[colnames(srt), "cytotrace"], col.name = "cytotrace")

  cytotrace_results[[nm]] <- srt

  gc()
}
```

```{r cytotrace-umap-tabs}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 5

for (nm in SUBSET_NAMES) {
  cat("\n\n### ", nm, " — UMAP\n\n")

  srt <- cytotrace_results[[nm]]

  umap_emb <- Seurat::Embeddings(srt, "umap.nn")[, 1:2] %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    setNames(c("UMAP1", "UMAP2")) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("cell.name") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(cytotrace = srt$cytotrace)

  # Order cells by expression if requested (high values plotted on top)
  if (ORDER_CELLS) {
    umap_emb <- umap_emb %>% dplyr::arrange(cytotrace)
  }

  # CytoTRACE UMAP
  p_cytotrace <- ggplot(umap_emb, aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, colour = cytotrace)) +
    geom_point(size = 0.7, alpha = 0.6) +
    scale_colour_viridis_c(option = "magma") +
    labs(title = paste0(nm, " — CytoTRACE score"),
         colour = "CytoTRACE") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(legend.position = "right")

  print(p_cytotrace)
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

```{r cytotrace-violin-tabs}
#| results: asis
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 6

for (nm in SUBSET_NAMES) {
  cat("\n\n### ", nm, " — Violin by cluster\n\n")

  srt <- cytotrace_results[[nm]]

  # Get cluster column
  clust_col <- cluster_col_res(srt@meta.data, INSPECT_RES)

  # Prepare data for violin plot
  plot_df <- tibble::tibble(
    cluster   = srt@meta.data[[clust_col]],
    cytotrace = srt$cytotrace
  )

  # Order clusters by median CytoTRACE (highest → lowest)
  cluster_order <- plot_df |>
    dplyr::group_by(cluster) |>
    dplyr::summarise(median_cytotrace = median(cytotrace, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
    dplyr::arrange(desc(median_cytotrace)) |>
    dplyr::pull(cluster)

  plot_df$cluster <- factor(plot_df$cluster, levels = cluster_order)

  # CytoTRACE violin
  p_cytotrace_violin <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = cluster, y = cytotrace, fill = cluster)) +
    geom_violin(scale = "width", alpha = 0.7, show.legend = FALSE) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, alpha = 0.5, outlier.size = 0.5, show.legend = FALSE) +
    labs(title = paste0(nm, " — CytoTRACE by cluster (res ", INSPECT_RES, ")"),
         x = "Cluster", y = "CytoTRACE score") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

  print(p_cytotrace_violin)

  rm(srt); gc()
  cat("\n\n")
}
```
